title: Gridfinity cutout library file
description: A cutout library item, or a library folder with everything in it, exported from the bin designer: shapes saved apart from any bin, with their groups and meshes, to place in another bin. Each cutout has the same shape as in a bin design. Unknown properties are allowed so newer files still validate. See https://gridfinitylayouttool.com/schema

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema. Ignored by the importer; present only so editors offer completion.

type.description: Document discriminator: one item, or a folder with its subfolders and items. The importer rejects any other value.

name.description: Item name, or the exported folder's name. An empty or missing name imports under a default one.

params.description: Item files only: the saved shapes.

folders.description: Folder files only: the folders inside the exported folder, at any depth. A folder file imports whole or not at all, so one bad entry refuses the file.

id.description: Unique within the file. Import gives every folder a new id.

name.description: Folder name. An empty or missing name imports under a default one.

parentId.description: The id of another folder in this file, or null (or missing) for a folder directly inside the exported folder. The parents must not form a loop.

items.description: Folder files only: every item in the exported folder and its subfolders.

name.description: Item name. An empty or missing name imports under a default one.

folderId.description: The id of a folder in this file, or null (or missing) for an item directly inside the exported folder.

LibraryParams.description: The saved shapes of one item, as the matching part of a bin design's params. Coordinates are mm with the origin at the bottom-left of the item's box; placing the item moves it to the drop point.

cutouts.description: The saved shapes. Ids only need to be unique within the item; placing the item gives each shape, group and mesh a new id.

cutoutGroupNames.description: Display names for the groups the shapes form, keyed by group id.

meshAssets.description: Imported STL imprint meshes, written inline, keyed by the id that a shape 'mesh' cutout's meshId references.
